comment: Probably the most impossible teacher I've ever had.  Treats his students as though they are in high school.  No gum, no cell phones, no books, and no taking notes.  Literally the most impossible teacher I've ever had.  Very headstrong.  Does not prepare you well for tests.  Expects hours of work before class. Not an easy A at all.  Take anyone else
Great professor! really cares about his students and very helpful outside the class!

This man is impossible. The course is very interesting but diffuclt to understand. If your a native speaker he will despise you.Very harsh and curt.If you are willing to do hours of thankless work take this class.

Although I wouldn't take his class again, I liked Ricardo. He's really out there, but interesting and mildly entertaining He is extremely demanding and picks favorites. However, after five years of Spanish, the class was insanely easy.
NO NO NO NO NO NO... if you would like to see your GPA go down go ahead NO NO NO NO NO NO

This professor is very diffricult....he has his favorites in everyclass....everyone says as the years goes by he get more diffricult.....welll figure it yourself and look at all the comment posted within the last two year....horrible!

This class is impossible.  In fact, this class would be impossible if it were taught in english.  However, the teacher doesnt realize this and then gets mad when you need asistance.  I would hate to be the guy to say "I told you so" so please dont take this, or you will come back here to give the same rating, and you will see that "I told you so"
Class is like milk...good for a week then unbearable after.

I would flag all of these ratings if I could.  3 hours of homework minimum before each class.  He isnt the man, he isnt funny, and this class alone will bring down your entire GPA.  If you like spanish dont take this class, because you will never take spanish again...Even for native students, this class is impossible.

Ricardo is such a wonderful professor.  He really cares about his students and helps them all of the time.  If he likes you, he'll even invite you over to his place for dinner and let you in on his personal life and will play hip music mixes that his hot girlfriend made...I would recommend him to anyone!

Ricardo is the man.  Although 305 was much harder than 221 (also taken with him), it was probably the only class that I learned a great deal in.  And you actually do learn Spanish.  Expectations are clearly defined and there is a good deal of work, but you will actually learn and be able to converse in spanish.  Also, NO professor is more helpful.

Excellent teacher; really really cares about his students and will work really hard to make sure everyone understands the material. Has a great sense of humor and is a lot of fun, makes Spanish enjoyable!!

Ricardo is absolutely the best professor at UR. Do anything possible to take this class. He writes REALLY good recommendations too (if he likes you). Plus he's an amazing cook and invites you for dinner.

AMAZING TEACHER!!! You must take his class. He's awesome. He invites you to his house for dinner if he likes you. I hated spanish at the beginning, but he makes it fun, and I like it now. If you can take ANY of his classes, do it. He's amazing.
ricardo is a great guy. he wants everybody to learn and has a lot of fun if everybody is interested. going to spanish everyday wasnt as bad as i thought it was going to be. i recommend him.
Ricardo is my hero. I used to hate spanish, but now i love it. i wish i could have him all year
great professor.  extremely fun, you can tell he loves his job and really cares about the students.  overall one of the best teachers i've ever had.
Ricardo is the man!! Very helpful and makes spanish easy and fun. Such a nice guy and would do anything to help his students.

MY FAVORITE TEACHER AT UR! the class is almost entirely discussion based, but if you're not intimidated, you will learn spanish faster than any other class. Well worth the effort he expects of his students
Not bad. Really intimidating at first.  If he likes you, then the class is easier.  Overall learned a lot but wouldn't take him again.  Lots of homework never collected.
Whole class is in spanish. Doesn't explain things well. Helpful outside of class. Homework due every class period which you never go over.

INCREDIBLE. Everyone should take at least one class with him. He loves his students and above all wants them to learn. He's challenging but also very flexible - if he sees the entire class is struggling he will change the way he teaches just so that everyone can actually understand what's going on and enjoy it. He's the reason why I'm a Sp minor.
he is very understanding, great teacher, lots of fun!

Really great prof. The class is hard; there's a lot of reading. Just the nature of a spanish LIT course. He expects a lot but at the same time he is incredibly fair and helpful outside of class, especially for the final paper. Doesn't like you missing class, but get on his good side early (talk in class a bit and look like you've done the work)

GREAT TEACHER! This course was extremely challenging for me personally. The course is designed to give all the responsibility to the students to get however much or however little they desire out of the course.  This course is not for those who do not want to work.  He expects a lot, but you learn a lot.  He is also extremely helpful outside of cla
Not the nicest guy. Does not like when you miss class. Basically makes his students teach the class. HW for every class, which is very annoying.
